import base64, hashlib, io, json, subprocess, sys, tempfile, zipfile
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
site = Path('products/sites/sqlite-join-exercise')
archives = sorted(site.rglob('*.zip.b64'))
result = {'scope': 'Staged free instructor download. Local execution supplies no redistribution grant, review approval, buyer feedback or revenue.', 'archive_candidates': [str(p) for p in archives]}
if len(archives) == 1:
    archive = archives[0]
    payload = base64.b64decode(b''.join(archive.read_bytes().split()), validate=True)
    result['decoded_archive_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(payload)) as z:
        files = [m for m in z.infolist() if not m.is_dir()]
        result['members'] = [{'path': m.filename, 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(z.read(m)).hexdigest()} for m in files]
        runners = [m for m in files if PurePosixPath(m.filename).name == 'run.py']
        safe_paths = all(not PurePosixPath(m.filename).is_absolute() and '..' not in PurePosixPath(m.filename).parts and '\\' not in m.filename for m in files)
        unique_paths = len({m.filename for m in files}) == len(files)
        if safe_paths and unique_paths and len(runners) == 1:
            with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
                for member in files:
                    target = Path(tmp) / member.filename
                    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                    target.write_bytes(z.read(member))
                runner = Path(tmp) / runners[0].filename
                run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, runner.name], cwd=runner.parent, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
                result['learner_command'] = 'python3 run.py'
                result['execution'] = {'returncode': run.returncode, 'stdout': run.stdout, 'stderr': run.stderr}
        else:
            result['execution_gap'] = 'Expected safe unique member paths and exactly one run.py.'
else:
    result['execution_gap'] = 'Expected one staged base64 ZIP.'
path = Path('products/distribution/sqlite-instructor-pilot/staged-download-receipt.json')
path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
path.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
